name: s81sl_cap_ld
structural_change: LEAD2-S81/TOK2 10-19 TOK.DS.BENCH.1: NEW leaf ot_s81sl_cap_ld (static 70-b lane delay D=16 on W lane 3 = R01 before u_tw): the W tree carries four QF frames, so the E-only delay cannot pack; exact repack s_16_24 (W lane 3 +16, E +24) and the fullsix l16e24 rerun show no tree fault (only the expected reset-CAP F9). ot_hdc_delay_rf 70 x 14 = 980 b, primed valid. +16 edges on R01 words.

job.purpose: TOK.DS.BENCH.1: W lane-3 static delay leaf (D=16) before u_tw in ot_s81sl_cap; benched standalone (tb_s81sl_cap_ld base + D15/D17 RTL mutants).

pin_regs.reason: Source-registered: ot_hdc_delay_rf lands the lane in its pin input register and drives it from its pin output register; recipe-3 pin_regs would add unpriced edges to the D=16 calendar.

why_floorplan: 43.2 x 43.2 (core 38.88^2 = 1,512 um2; ~1.12k flops + 14:1 x 70 read mux, est. ~730 um2 std from the cap_ed gate ratio -> ~48 % util, square): lane word in W face (70 pins / 29 um = 2.4/um, from the CAP lane-3 input), out E face (to u_tw lane 3), clk/rst_n S face mid; no macros, one band, one root.
